description:
Create professional videos with ease! This add-on allows you to:
- Create slideshow videos from photos and videos with audio
- Add captions to individual photos and videos
- Create running text/ticker videos from text and audio
- Apply transitions between photos/videos
- Remove green/blue backgrounds from photos
- Use custom backgrounds (black, white, or custom image)
- Ken Burns zoom effect
- Watermark your videos
- Save and load projects

Keyboard Shortcuts:
- NVDA+Shift+3: Create video from photos/videos and audio
- NVDA+Shift+4: Create running text video

Note: Requires ffmpeg to be installed in the add-on directory.
changelog:
Version 1.0.0:
- Initial release with full video creation features
- Support for photos and videos as source material
- Running text/ticker video creation
- Background removal from photos (green/blue screen)
- Custom backgrounds (black, white, or custom image)
- Pause/Resume/Cancel progress dialog
- Caption support with proper text rendering
- Ken Burns zoom effect
- Various transitions between clips
- Watermark support
- Save and load projects
- Configurable quality settings (SD, HD, Full HD)
